answer: A running club membership with race results works as the gate: results filed under one club's name for years. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. Each of 481 aliases needs its own race results, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. A inlet marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the umber ledger turns 481 aliases into 481 bills while the mirror path for the honest stays a single payment.
